admission.justification: Realized by the communication Node selector and by the harness-home status and restart check; tests prove the old Node is used only for talking to a running host and that a home change refuses before any stop. Without it a build change cuts the bridge to the host or a restart loses agent sessions.

applicability: Commands that talk to the product's running host, and provisioning that would stop and restart it.
conditions: Communication uses the product Node when it is installed, otherwise the executable of the proven owned running host.
Before a stop, the harness-home variables the running host holds are compared with what the new host would receive.
exclusions: Starting or restarting a host, which uses only the product Node.
An unreadable host environment, which reports unknown and adds no refusal.
A provisioning run with the explicit accept-change option.
